title: Umami French Chestnut Mushroom Terrine
description: A keto-friendly French dish featuring chestnut mushrooms, with a citrusy and crunchy texture, cooked in a clay pot and formed into a terrine, served in a hot pot vessel.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 300 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large skillet, saute the shallots and garlic in duck fat until softened.
Add the chestnut mushrooms to the skillet and cook until they release their liquid and start to brown.
Stir in the thyme, salt, and black pepper, and cook for 1 minute.
In a large bowl, combine the cooked mushroom mixture, lemon zest, egg, and heavy cream, and mix well.
Transfer the mixture to a hot pot vessel and smooth the top.
Cover the vessel with a lid and place it in the oven to cook for 25 minutes.
Remove the vessel from the oven and let it cool to room temperature.
Refrigerate the terrine for at least 2 hours before serving.
Slice the terrine into thick slices and serve chilled.
